tasks.subject: Task 1: rm_files::Page::scene_bytes()
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Expose raw per-page `.rm` bytes (None when un-inked) so the device-pull can feed them to `read_ink` in `.content` order.

**Files:**
- Modify: `crates/rm-files/src/bundle/mod.rs`
- Test: `crates/rm-files/tests/bundle.rs`

**Verify:** `cargo test -p rm-files --test bundle scene_bytes`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rm-files/src/bundle/mod.rs", "crates/rm-files/tests/bundle.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p rm-files --test bundle scene_bytes", "acceptanceCriteria": ["scene_bytes returns Some raw bytes for inked page", "returns None for un-inked page", "pages in .content order"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: serve::strokes_by_page + multi-page pull_ink (with e2e test)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Assemble per-page ink in `.content` order on the device-pull path and prove it end-to-end without a device.

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/reading-queue/Cargo.toml`
- Modify: `apps/reading-queue/src/serve.rs`
- Create: `apps/reading-queue/tests/multipage.rs`
- Stage: `Cargo.lock`

**Verify:** `cargo test -p reading-queue --test multipage && cargo test -p reading-queue`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/reading-queue/Cargo.toml", "apps/reading-queue/src/serve.rs", "apps/reading-queue/tests/multipage.rs", "Cargo.lock"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p reading-queue --test multipage && cargo test -p reading-queue", "acceptanceCriteria": ["strokes_by_page returns per-page vec sized to bundle pages in .content order", "pull_ink uses it, skip-empty preserved", "caveat removed", "e2e: per-page alignment, split stitching, empty-middle no-shift"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Docs sweep + workspace-green gate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Ensure no doc implies a single-page device pull and the whole workspace tests green.

**Files:**
- Inspect/Modify only if needed: `docs/appdx.md`, `docs/how-it-works.md`, `docs/remarkable-pdf-mechanics.md`

**Verify:** `cargo test --workspace`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/appdx.md", "docs/how-it-works.md", "docs/remarkable-pdf-mechanics.md"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test --workspace", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no single-page-pull implication in docs", "cargo test --workspace green"]}
```
